svg.aria-label: In Drydock: Iris Clew, under construction. Every comment deserves a reply. Iris makes sure none slip. An agent that keeps track of comments across my dev.to posts and helps reshape each piece for X, daily.dev, and AWS Builder. It asks me for what only I know and learns from my decisions. I still write every reply myself.
